name: Sales-Forecasting-Demand-Intelligence
description: An end-to-end retail demand intelligence platform that combines time series forecasting, anomaly detection, product demand segmentation, and interactive business dashboards to enable data-driven inventory and sales planning.

paragraphs: This project presents a comprehensive system for sales forecasting and demand intelligence, designed to provide actionable insights from sales data. It features an interactive web application built with Streamlit, offering a dynamic dashboard for data visualization, anomaly detection, and customer/product segmentation. The application is styled with a custom "command deck" dark theme for an engaging user experience, empowering businesses to make data-driven decisions.
features: Interactive Sales Dashboard: A user-friendly web interface built with Streamlit for real-time sales data exploration.
Dynamic Data Visualization: Utilize Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to visualize sales trends, patterns, and key performance indicators.
Anomaly Detection: Employ Isolation Forest to automatically identify unusual sales activities or outliers, highlighting potential issues or opportunities.
Customer/Product Segmentation: Implement KMeans clustering to segment customers or products, aiding in targeted marketing and strategy development.
Data Preprocessing: Includes robust data cleaning, scaling (StandardScaler), and dimensionality reduction (PCA) techniques for model readiness.
